dialogues.speaker: Ancient Swordsman's Inscriptions (III)
dialogues.text: "...Sword dancing beneath the autumn moon, soaring song and incessant sighs..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Swordsman's Inscriptions (III)
dialogues.text: "...Where the adepti live near waters clear, where the white stones stand so tall..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Swordsman's Inscriptions (III)
dialogues.text: "...I remove my hat and drink to you..."
